title: double the replay buffer
mechanism: Store more labeled frames and replay uniformly.
reason: Rare recall improved two points but power and memory costs increased.

title: four-bit backbone quantization
mechanism: Quantize the current backbone more aggressively.
reason: Saved memory but did not alter adaptation behavior under compound drift.

title: nightly federated averaging
mechanism: Run the existing global update more frequently.
reason: Increased correlated errors and erased useful specialists.

title: larger teacher distillation
mechanism: Distill a larger central teacher into every robot.
reason: Requires central access to frames and preserves one global ontology.

title: confidence-based pseudo-labeling
mechanism: Self-train on high-confidence local predictions.
reason: Amplified shared blind spots after label delay.

title: tune learning-rate schedule
mechanism: Search a broader set of optimizer schedules.
reason: Incremental benchmark gain did not address site transfers.

title: compress gradients further
mechanism: Reduce the bytes in conventional gradient exchange.
reason: Near the link ceiling and weak at identifying the changed relation.

title: central active labeling queue
mechanism: Send uncertain frames to a shared human queue.
reason: Raw-image transfer violates policy and labels arrive too late.

title: monthly model reset
mechanism: Reset every robot to the global checkpoint monthly.
reason: Destroyed gradual local adaptation.

title: single site-aware adapter
mechanism: Add one learned site embedding to the global model.
reason: Static site identity did not capture zone or shift recurrence.

title: bigger synthetic augmentation set
mechanism: Generate more appearance variants for training.
reason: Coverage grew but the proposal remained an offline data-scale extension.

title: one universal calibration layer
mechanism: Calibrate all robot outputs to one threshold.
reason: Concealed coherent minority-site failures.

title: expand memory variant 1
mechanism: Increase storage or replay frequency without changing the learning relation.
reason: It conflicts with a hard deployment constraint.

title: shrink model variant 1
mechanism: Reduce parameters or precision while preserving the same global objective.
reason: It duplicates an earlier incremental line of work.

title: tune optimizer variant 1
mechanism: Search local hyperparameters inside the existing training loop.
reason: It improves the mean metric without rare-regime robustness.

title: add labels variant 1
mechanism: Request more labels through the existing delayed pipeline.
reason: It changes scale but not the system's hidden assumptions.
